summary: Restoration pledges include 12,285 ha/year of reforestation (≈0.28% of current forest area), restoration of 25% of priority degraded forests and 35% of degraded coastal wetlands/mangroves by 2030, and enhanced natural regeneration in 5% of priority degraded forests by 2035. Conservation targets 1.5 million ha of protected forest and 1 million ha of community forest by 2030—about 34% and 23% of current forest cover—plus 30% mangrove protection, four marine/coastal areas, 200,000 ha of protected areas by 2029, and a 64% emissions cut versus BAU by 2035. Agriculture targets 1.15 million ha of crops and pasture by 2030 (22.4% of current agricultural area), 5,000 farmers, 60% lower fertilizer use, 30% less residue burning and 60% alternative wetting and drying in rice cultivation. Mixed pledges cover 100,000 ha of degraded-land concessions, 50 ha/year of urban restoration in each of five cities, and forest catchments with 100% cataloguing by 2029 and 50% under management plans by 2030.
